question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Laconic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Verbose**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Laconic"** refers to a style of speaking or writing that is brief, concise, and to the point. (संक्षिप्त, अल्पभाषी)

 
 
• **Example:** His laconic response made it clear that he was not interested in the discussion.
 
 
 
• **"Verbose"** means using more words than necessary, often leading to lengthy and overly detailed communication. (अतिविस्तृत, शब्दाडंबर)
 
 
• **Example:** The professor’s verbose explanation confused the students instead of clarifying the topic.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Laconic'** is **'Verbose'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Verbose**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Concise** (संक्षिप्त): Giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words.

 
 
• **Example:** The report was concise and covered all the major points.
 
 
 
• **Terse** (संक्षिप्त और कठोर): Brief and to the point, sometimes appearing rude.
 
 
• **Example:** Her terse reply indicated that she was annoyed by the question.
 
 
 
• **Succinct** (संक्षिप्त): Expressed clearly and briefly.
 
 
• **Example:** His succinct explanation made the complex concept easy to understand.
